en_title: Ubisoft Gives Free PC Copies to Xbox Owners of Select Games
cn_title: 育碧向XBOX玩家免费赠送部分游戏PC版
subtitle: 主机购买可获PC版

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft is giving Xbox owners free access to some of their games on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧正向XBOX玩家免费提供部分游戏的PC版。

paragraphs.en: Today, Ubisoft and Xbox revealed a new expansion to their ongoing partnership. Starting immediately, those who own the following games on Xbox will get them for free on PC through Ubisoft Connect by August 4th:
paragraphs.cn: 育碧和XBOX今日宣布扩大双方持续进行的合作。即日起，拥有以下XBOX游戏的玩家将在8月4日前通过Ubisoft Connect免费获得PC版：

paragraphs.en: The games should appear in your Ubisoft Connect library by next week, so long as your accounts are linked. If you happen to purchase these games on Xbox later, you will get them on PC automatically. Unfortunately, this doesn't go both ways. If you buy one of these games on PC first, you will not get it on Xbox. If you're someone who previously played on console, but made the jump to PC, this is a great benefit.
paragraphs.cn: 只要关联账户，这些游戏下周就应出现在你的Ubisoft Connect库中。之后在XBOX购买这些游戏，也会自动获得PC版；但反向不成立，先在PC购买不会获得XBOX版。对从主机转到PC的玩家而言，这是很实在的福利。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, Ubisoft has also added a bunch of premium editions for Ubisoft games like Assassin's Creed Shadows to Xbox's PC app. Recently, Xbox has been making a lot of moves toward PC. It's unclear if this is all part of one big deliberate plan or if it's coincidental, but last week, Xbox made select backward-compatible titles for the OG Xbox available on PC . More titles are expected to be added in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，育碧还将《刺客信条：影》等游戏的多个高级版加入XBOX PC应用。XBOX近期不断向PC靠拢；尚不清楚这是否为统一计划，但上周它已让部分初代XBOX向后兼容游戏登陆PC，未来预计会加入更多作品。

paragraphs.en: There are also rumors that Microsoft is planning a feature that will let players digitize their physical games library , possibly ahead of the next Xbox console. However, with this ongoing shift toward PC, it could make them accessible on PC. It's believed the next Xbox is expected to be more PC-like, so this could all be part of one big initatitve to prepare for the next-generation of Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 另有传闻称，微软计划推出让玩家把实体游戏库数字化的功能，可能为下一代XBOX铺路。随着持续向PC转型，这些游戏或可在PC访问；外界认为下一代XBOX会更接近PC，这可能都是为新主机准备的一部分。

summary: 育碧与XBOX扩大合作，部分已购XBOX游戏将于8月4日前通过Ubisoft Connect免费提供PC版，反向购买则不适用。此举延续了XBOX近期向PC靠拢的策略。
opus_summary: XBOX玩家获得育碧PC版的单向福利，既方便从主机转投PC的用户，也让微软向PC生态转型的路线更加清晰，并为下一代主机的跨平台策略预热。
